mapper.select: SELECT provider_type AS platformType, external_store_id AS externalStoreId, store_name AS storeName, enabled FROM external_stores WHERE provider_type = #{platformType} AND enabled = 1 ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT provider_type AS platformType, external_store_id AS externalStoreId, external_menu_id AS externalMenuId, catalog_key AS catalogKey, menu_name AS menuName, price, enabled FROM external_menus WHERE provider_type = #{platformType} AND external_store_id = #{externalStoreId} AND enabled = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT provider_type AS platformType, external_store_id AS externalStoreId, store_name AS storeName, enabled FROM external_stores WHERE provider_type = #{platformType} AND external_store_id = #{externalStoreId} LIMIT 1

SELECT provider_type AS platformType, external_store_id AS externalStoreId, external_menu_id AS externalMenuId, catalog_key AS catalogKey, menu_name AS menuName, price, enabled FROM external_menus WHERE provider_type = #{platformType} AND external_menu_id = #{externalMenuId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO external_stores ( provider_type, external_store_id, store_name, enabled ) VALUES ( #{platformType}, #{request.externalStoreId}, #{request.storeName}, #{request.enabled} )

INSERT INTO external_menus ( provider_type, external_store_id, external_menu_id, catalog_key, menu_name, price, enabled, sort_order ) VALUES ( #{platformType}, #{externalStoreId}, #{request.externalMenuId}, #{request.catalogKey}, #{request.menuName}, #{request.price}, #{request.enabled}, #{request.sortOrder} )
